The first public release of Lazy Deck. 🦥

Download **lazy-deck-0.5.1.streamDeckPlugin** below and double-click it. Stream Deck installs the plugin along with a ready-made profile and alarm profile for your device.

- **Sam**, the sloth, sleeps on your deck and takes over the whole deck when something needs you: a failing build, a waiting review, a finished Steam download.
- **100+ keys** for music, Discord, Steam, volume per app, brightness, radio, timers, Pomodoro, windows and everyday tools.
- **Every Stream Deck**: Mini, Neo, +, Stream Deck, XL, Studio, + XL, Mobile, Virtual Stream Deck and Galleon 100 SD.
- **Any script can wake Sam up** with one local call: `curl "http://127.0.0.1:47321/alert?level=error&title=Build%20failed"`
